And it was very much born out of a world that was becoming increasingly online. So whereas since the 1960s, our understanding of what research impact has been has been defined by scientific journals and by the citations between the scientific journals. Altmetrics seeks to expand that idea of what impact of research is to use data that comes from around the world and from many different areas.
